# Elasticsearch Kibana Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Database > Elasticsearch

## Overview

Builds Kibana dashboards and visualizations for Elasticsearch data including Lens, Canvas, and alerting configuration

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [elasticsearch-kibana-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
elasticsearch-kibana-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@elasticsearch-kibana-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Build dashboards with Lens and Canvas
- Configure Kibana alerts and actions
- Create saved searches and visualizations
- Implement Kibana Spaces for multi-tenancy

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Kibana Dashboards**: Dashboard design and visualization patterns
- **Alerting**: Rule types and action configuration
- **Spaces**: Multi-tenancy and access control
